title: Has higher sides, potatoes stuck using avocado oil,
text:
Has higher sides, potatoes stuck using avocado oil,. This stainless steel pan has allot to offer, beside looking shiny and nice.
Works with different heat source, Gas, Induction, ceramic, oven safe 500 degrees F. I notice the handle did not
Get hot on my gas stove top, but it will in the oven, as all cookware will.
I like that the sides are higher.
That said, this is very light weight stainess pan . I steamed red skin potatoes in a steamer, then cut them up, put them in this pan
Using Organic Avocado oil that can take a high heat, and they kept sticking to the pan. I put more oil in, then
I put a little water in the pan, as i didnt want to turn the heat Up higher and end up deep frying the patatoes. We dont eat fried foods.
These tasted good with seasoning etc on them and a little butter, but i have used my older, made in the Usa Farberware stainless pans
With out having potatoes sticking to the pan like these did. I did not have a high flame going.
I realize this pan is not non-srick but also using my cast iron pans and potatoes do not stick like this pan did.

When the pan cooled down i put soap and hot water in the pan, let it soak for about 10 mins, washed this with my kitchen brush
With soap on it, and it cleaned pretty good. I had to use the brushes flat part to get the crispies unstuck, but it looked
Like new after. This pan can go in the dishwasher, but i didn't want all that stuff shooting all over my dishwasher.
I now wonder if I sauté veggies in this will they stick!

If I find veggies are not stinking etc, I will be back to update and change my stars.
